name: Ehsan Salimi
title: Software Developer & ML Researcher
tagline: Master's student in Computer Science at Concordia University, working on AI for medical imaging. I build machine-learning pipelines and the software around them.
availability: Open to part-time roles now, and full-time roles from 2027.
about: I'm a software developer and machine-learning researcher, currently a master's student at Concordia University in Montreal, working on AI for medical imaging.

Before that I completed an Honours BSc in Computer Science at the University of Windsor, worked as a research assistant on machine learning for vehicle-network security and online-safety NLP, interned on Bettermode's Slack integration, and debugged customer integrations and scripts at Oracle NetSuite.
I like building systems end to end: the data pipeline and model, and the APIs and interfaces around them.
